worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$\land$".

So, the sentence reads

\[
\underbrace{2 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is odd} }_P \quad \underbrace{\vphantom{p}\textbf{and}}_{\land} \quad \underbrace{3 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is prime} }_Q,
\]

that is, $P \land Q.$
